diagnostics.check: On [0,1], p=q=1/2, F_e=0: the printed endpoint interpolation gives 1/2 while r(p,p)=0. First subdivide at q; the interpolation is used with q a model vertex in the tau proof.
diagnostics.implication_boundary: Does not refute Theorem 11.2 or the Wang proof; their base point is a vertex.

diagnostics.locator: Actual PDF pp.13--14, Theorem 5.4, first proof display on p.14
diagnostics.check: The sum indexed by f has ell(e) printed in its denominator. The statement and Proposition 5.3 use ell(f). For the tree u--v--p with lengths 1,2, q=u, contracting e=uv leaves r(p,q)=2 and r(v,q)=0. The corrected bracket is -2/2+2=1; the literal bracket is -2/1+2=0. P(e,f)=1 on this tree.
diagnostics.implication_boundary: Replace the summand denominator by ell(f); no final tau/moment identity is refuted.

diagnostics.locator: Actual PDF pp.12--14 Definition 5.2(ii)/Theorem 5.4; pp.17--18 zero-diagonal Z and AZ
diagnostics.check: As defined, t(p,e) includes f=e. A single unit edge with q=v,p=u has P(e)=1 and t=1, but the displayed Theorem 5.4 expression is 0. With Z diagonal zero, AZ delta_e equals t minus P(e)(delta_u+delta_v). The consistent auxiliary definition is t_0(p,e)=sum over incident f different from e of P(e,f).
diagnostics.implication_boundary: Use the off-diagonal t_0 throughout these auxiliary steps. Separate diagonal terms in later formulas remain. This check does not refute the final moment identity.

diagnostics.locator: Cinkir actual pp.4--6 optimal vertex set/Theorem 1.1; Wang actual p.5 Theorem 2.7
diagnostics.check: The Cinkir entry -1/L_uv presupposes a simple model. Parallel edges require a sum of conductances and an unsplit loop is invisible to the vertex Laplacian. Wang explicitly assumes a simple length-preserving vertex-transitive model for this input.
diagnostics.implication_boundary: No extension of that specialized matrix formula to arbitrary loop models is imported.

diagnostics.locator: Actual pp.9--10, reduction of bridges and two-edge cuts
diagnostics.check: For a two-edge cut, oriented e and f have x_e=x_f on every cycle. Contract f and increase L_e by L_f, retaining created loops. This preserves the integral cycle lattice with its energy inner product and total length. A circle becomes one loop; deleting that loop would destroy its moment.
diagnostics.implication_boundary: Distinguish this energy-preserving reduction from resistance-only contraction/removal of parallel loops in the moments paper.

diagnostics.locator: Height actual pp.4--6 Theorems A/B and (1.11), p.31; Wang actual pp.11--12 Remark 4.5
diagnostics.check: The height formula coefficient 2/[k:Q] multiplies a local invariant equal to half the tropical moment. Their product gives 1/[k:Q] times the full moment, as Wang writes. Unit local graph lengths use v(uniformizer)=1; the arithmetic finite-place term carries log N(v).
diagnostics.implication_boundary: Only a number field, semistable smooth projective geometrically connected curve of genus at least two and the geometric dual graph of its minimal regular model are in this application. Archimedean terms remain. Selected height pages do not certify the unread external proof chain.

diagnostics.check: Leading principal minors >=1 imply partial sums of log LDL pivots >=0, not individual pivots >=1. With a_i decreasing, Abel summation makes sum a_i log q_i>=0; q_i>=1+log q_i yields the weighted trace bound.
diagnostics.implication_boundary: No false assertion that every LDL pivot is at least one is used.

diagnostics.check: Independent lattice-dual coordinates define a surjective torus map W/Lambda to R^S/Z^S even when the integer image T(Lambda) has proper index. Haar pushforward is uniform; the periodized marginal sums to one, so each density is <=1. The determinant covariance lower bound follows from the Gaussian integral and Jensen.
diagnostics.implication_boundary: Primitive dual coordinates are not an extra assumption. The admitted input, if used, remains the author-attributed lattice bound, not a new result.

diagnostics.locator: Wang actual pp.8--10; Edmonds actual pp.3--5 Theorem 1 and proof
diagnostics.check: Coordinate duals indexed by S have rank |S|-c(G\S)+1 and are independent exactly when G\S is connected. After bridge/two-cut reduction each proper component has cut degree at least three; 3c<=2|S| gives |S|<=3rank(S). Edmonds gives a partition into three independent sets.
diagnostics.implication_boundary: The matroid is cographic. A partition into ordinary graphic forests would be a different assertion.

diagnostics.check: From R<=6*pi*e*I=(3*pi*e/4)*ell*(1-4t), ell^3<=A R^2 and t>=A/(12ell), obtain t(1-4t)^2>=4/(27*pi^2*e^2). Its derivative is (1-4t)(1-12t), strictly positive on (0,1/12). For t>=1/12 the lower bound t>=c_- is already true.
diagnostics.implication_boundary: No premise t<=1/12 is silently imposed on all graphs.

diagnostics.locator: Actual pp.12--15 cubic construction and exact resistance/Foster calculation
diagnostics.status: independent targeted numerical and rational source checks pass
diagnostics.check: Constructed Gamma_M directly for M=3,4,5, checked simplicity/cubic degree, counts 6M^2/9M^2 and total length 15M^2. Positive Laplacian pseudoinverse independently reproduces both exact Foster coefficients, their trace, tau basepoint independence and the transitive formula. Symbolic triangle--star energy identity and rational asymptotic/finite M=300 inequalities pass.
diagnostics.implication_boundary: Small-network computations are diagnostics, not a proof for all M. The all-M proof and explicit M>=300 counterexamples are Wang source results, not original admissions.

diagnostics.locator: Actual p.37 June 2005 footnote; pp.37--38 Conjecture 14.5
diagnostics.check: The v2 footnote says Cinkir had proved the conjecture with C=1/108. It is a historical added claim, not an independent proof in the selected text. Wang gives source-attributed cubic examples below 1/108, while proving a smaller uniform constant.
diagnostics.implication_boundary: Do not repeat the old footnote as the current established sharp bound or claim to have read the corresponding 2007 published PDF.

diagnostics.check: For one unit edge the two grounded inverses average to I/2, whereas Q^+=Q/4. The correct matrix formula is Q^+=H((1/n)sum L_q)H, H=I-11^T/n. The uncentered average is still a generalized inverse and gives the same zero-mass energy pairing.
diagnostics.implication_boundary: Proposition 5.2 and Theorem 7.8 explicitly permit any generalized inverse; their formulas remain valid. Wang uses the genuinely centered Moore--Penrose inverse.

diagnostics.locator: Actual pp.18--19 Theorem 8.2 and first proof paragraph; p.3 Theorem B
diagnostics.check: Take Gamma=[0,2], e=[0,1] and nu=delta_(1/4)-delta_(3/4). Collapsing e pushes nu to zero, so quotient energy is zero. The printed single rank-one formula gives 1/2-(1/2)^2/1=1/4. Its proof requires e to be one model edge AND both measures supported on model vertices; these cannot both hold for charges in the interior of e. A valid single-edge formula restricts their supports outside the open edge; otherwise subdivide and contract the resulting edges successively.
diagnostics.implication_boundary: This refutes the literal arbitrary-support Theorem 8.2, not the vertex-supported formula. Wang cites Theorem 7.8, which does not use this contraction theorem. The moments proof uses model vertices outside the contracted open edge.
